mapper.select: select count(*) from media_event where create_time >= curdate() and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day)
select count(*) from media_event where event_type = #{eventType}
select coalesce(sum(value_num), 0) from media_event where event_type = #{eventType}
select stat_date, coalesce(sum(cnt), 0) as cnt from media_stats_daily where stat_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{offsetDays} day) group by stat_date order by stat_date asc

select t.target_key as `key`, (select v.title from media_video v where v.id = t.target_key) as `title`, t.cnt as `count` from (select target_key, count(*) as cnt from media_event where event_type = 'play' and target_key <> '' group by target_key order by cnt desc, target_key asc limit #{limit}) t order by t.cnt desc, t.target_key asc
select target_key as `key`, count(*) as `count` from media_event where event_type = 'photo_click' and target_key <> '' group by target_key order by count(*) desc, target_key asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into media_stats_daily (stat_date, event_type, target_type, target_key, cnt, value_sum) select #{statDate}, e.event_type, e.target_type, e.target_key, count(*), coalesce(sum(e.value_num), 0) from media_event e where e.create_time >= #{statDate} and e.create_time < date_add(#{statDate}, interval 1 day) group by e.event_type, e.target_type, e.target_key
mapper.select: select count(distinct owner_key) from media_event where create_time >= curdate() and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) and owner_key is not null and owner_key <> ''
select count(distinct owner_key) from media_event where owner_key is not null and owner_key <> ''
select count(*) from media_event where event_type = 'play_end'
select count(*) from media_event where event_type = 'play_end' and progress >= #{progress}
select count(*) from media_event where target_type = #{targetType} and target_key = #{targetKey} and event_type = #{eventType}
select count(*) from media_event where target_type = #{targetType} and target_key = #{targetKey} and event_type = 'play_end'
select coalesce(sum(value_num), 0) from media_event where target_type = #{targetType} and target_key = #{targetKey} and event_type = 'play_end'

select date(create_time) as stat_date, count(*) as cnt from media_event where target_type = #{targetType} and target_key = #{targetKey} and event_type = #{eventType} and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{offsetDays} day) and create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) group by date(create_time) order by stat_date asc
select title from media_video where id = #{videoId}
mapper.update: create table if not exists media_event_archive like media_event
mapper.insert: insert into media_event_archive (id, event_type, target_type, target_key, owner_key, value_num, progress, ip, user_agent, create_time) select id, event_type, target_type, target_key, owner_key, value_num, progress, ip, user_agent, create_time from media_event where create_time < #{before}
